profile.name: Md Asif Raza
profile.tagline: I build end-to-end applications that bring ideas to life — from designing robust backends and databases to creating intuitive interfaces and intelligent solutions.

about.heading: I build things that are secure on the back and simple on the front.
paragraphs: I’m a full-stack engineer at LTM Limited, working in the .NET ecosystem: C#, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Entity Framework Core and Angular. Most of my day goes into clean REST APIs, JWT-based auth and typed frontends that are easy to maintain.

Outside work I build products I want to exist: a hyperlocal freelancer finder, a street-food map for stalls too small for Google Maps, and a local-LLM research assistant. I like problems that sit between data and AI.

projects.title: Feedora
projects.tagline: QR review flow that turns real customer feedback into Google reviews.
projects.problem: Happy customers rarely leave reviews because writing one feels like work. Feedora puts a QR code on the table: customers rate their visit in seconds, can get an AI draft built only from their own feedback, edit it or write their own, and post it on Google themselves.
highlights: Supabase backend with Row Level Security, five Edge Functions, and separate owner and admin portals
Server-side AI drafts (OpenRouter, Gemini or OpenAI) that match the rating, with per-visit and per-venue rate limits
No review gating: every rating gets the same path to Google, tracked in a scan-to-click analytics funnel

projects.title: Neighborlly
projects.tagline: Find skilled freelancers within 5 km of you.
projects.problem: Local talent (tutors, electricians, designers) is hard to discover by distance. Neighborlly shows who’s nearby on a live map and lets you chat instantly.
highlights: Geospatial discovery with Leaflet.js + Turf.js radius queries
Responsive UI with React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui; tested with 50+ mock users

projects.title: AI Research Assistant
projects.tagline: Ask questions across academic papers, answered by a local LLM.
projects.problem: Skimming dozens of papers for one answer is slow. This RAG app retrieves the relevant passages with semantic search and summarises them with a locally hosted model.
highlights: Qdrant vector search over 100+ research articles
LangChain retrieval pipeline with Ollama for fully local inference

projects.title: Adda – Apna Adda
projects.tagline: A map of the street-food stalls Google Maps forgot.
projects.problem: The best chai tapri or thela has no Google listing. Adda maps them with live-camera photos, real opening hours, ratings and in-app directions.
highlights: Live camera capture only, so every stall photo is genuine
Gmail login, admin approval flow, ratings & reviews

projects.title: Sign Language Interpreter
projects.tagline: Real-time hand-sign recognition with speech output.
projects.problem: Bridging sign language and speech in real time using only a webcam: detect the hand, classify the gesture, speak the word.
highlights: TensorFlow gesture classifier trained on 100+ collected samples
Speech output and modular retraining for new signs
